vibe_rationale: Free council-run skate weekend with music and lessons; welcoming, but thin on curation and subculture depth.
fit_notes: Family-leaning youth skate programme (more than 10,000 kids since 2015), so the adult fit is weak. Fourteen partners and government backers, with a partnership page and contact email. Giveaways and sampling are already part of the format, which suits local sampling but not brand positioning. US-based.
